shared_elements: figures shown in profile with raised/extended arms
justification: The only real overlap is that both surfaces depict anthropomorphic figures in profile with arms extended, plus rows of repeated small motifs (feathers/rosettes in A, crew strokes and small figures in B), which is about as generic as figural correspondence gets. A shows a single large, richly detailed naturalistic winged composite being with a bird head, a bucket-like handled vessel and an elaborate plant/rosette border, whereas B shows numerous tiny, wholly schematic stick figures, footprint-like signs and multiple boats with crew strokes scattered over an open surface with no framing or central figure.
